revisions.note: No protected hash had to be re-pinned for the A32 assets themselves: all 10 hard pins were held byte-identical in this session. The one byte change is a NEW pin (INV-10) on scripts/s10plus-debug-pack/nuxel-live.sh, whose old->new hash pair, reason and authorising briQ are recorded in BASELINE-PROTECTION.md §9.4. The single hard FAIL of the re-run was repository hygiene - .gitignore's directory-only '.venv/' rule made `git check-ignore .venv` false on a fresh clone - and it is fixed by changing the rule to '.venv' (authorised by this briQ and by briq-00a revision 4; §6 of the register now carries an explicit correction). Regression rule defined for every later group: a protected hash may change only via an explicit work-queue revision that names the authorising briQ, and the behavioural assertions must still pass - a re-pin is a claim, not a proof.
